sources.title: Job boards
sources.description: Which boards to read: "remoteok" (Remote OK) and "jobicy" (Jobicy). Leave empty for both.

tags.title: Tags / categories
tags.description: Keep jobs with any of these tags or categories, e.g. "javascript", "design", "marketing" (Remote OK tags and Jobicy categories). Case-insensitive, matches part of a tag. Leave empty for every job.

search.title: Keyword search
search.description: Only keep jobs whose title, company or description contains this keyword (case-insensitive).

locations.title: Locations
locations.description: Keep jobs open to any of these places, e.g. "USA", "Europe", "Worldwide". Jobs that don't name a location are open to anywhere and are kept.

postedWithinDays.title: Posted within (days)
postedWithinDays.description: Only jobs posted in the last N days. Jobicy's feed covers the last 7 days; Remote OK's goes back further.

onlyWithSalary.title: Only jobs with a salary
onlyWithSalary.description: Skip jobs that don't publish a pay range.

maxItems.title: Max jobs to return
maxItems.description: Maximum number of jobs to save, newest first.

includeDescriptionHtml.title: Include the HTML description
includeDescriptionHtml.description: Add the original HTML description next to the plain-text one.

mode.title: Mode
enumTitles: Monitor: only jobs new since the last run
mode.description: Schedule monitor mode to get only the jobs posted since the previous run.

monitorStoreName.title: Monitor store name
monitorStoreName.description: Key-value store that remembers which jobs were already returned. Use a different name for each separate monitor.
